why: B: for every abstract Riemannian ℝⁿ-manifold M with ψ : M → ℝⁿ⁺¹ a smooth injective isometric map onto the unit sphere (n ≥ 1), any Levi-Civita connection, and q ≠ p, p' (via ψ): both Ω(M; p, q) (blind Om) and Ω* are homotopy equivalent to a Hausdorff Mathlib CWComplex with exactly one cell in each dimension k(n−1). A (universes 0): corollary_17_4 for the embedded Sⁿ ⊆ ℝⁿ⁺¹, n ≥ 2, Ω only: IsCountableCellComplexType (PathSp (Sph n) p q) (oneCellEach (k ↦ k(n−1))), i.e. homotopy equivalent to a mapping telescope of iterated adjunction spaces with non-cellular attaching maps, one cell of dimension k(n−1) at stage k+1; plus the general omega_cells_of_unique (any closed N with one non-degenerate geodesic per energy window) and strictMono_energy_sphGeod. A ⇒ B fails genuinely: project cell complex ⇒ Mathlib CWComplex needs cellular approximation (absent, as in V2_11/V2_12/V5_11); the case n = 1 (countably many 0-cells) is not in A; abstract M isometric to Sⁿ would need transport of Ω along ψ (inverse-function theorem on manifolds). B ⇒ A fails genuinely: a CW complex does not give the ordered tower; omega_cells_of_unique (general N) and the energy monotonicity are not in B.
overlap: No A_to_B/B_to_A. For A_to_A_emb (#rt_check OK): 802 shared project theorems — the Appendix mapping-telescope machinery reached through Morse.theorem_17_1 (Ω* ≃ PathC ≃ PathSp), slice-chart / riemDist / path-metric infrastructure of the Ω dictionary, and the sphere lemmas behind corollary_17_4's statement; none of the three theorems of the item.
